headline: Russian cargo ship remains on fire off Finland's coast after drone attack
summary: A Russian cargo ship remains on fire in the Gulf of Finland after a drone attack, and the armed forces say further attacks in the area cannot be ruled out.
why: Shipping through the Gulf of Finland, a route into the Baltic Sea, is sensitive to security risks that can affect freight insurance and rerouting costs.
original_headline: Buque de carga ruso sigue en llamas frente a las costas de Finlandia tras ataque con drones
